title: Home practical guide and safety card: red cabbage indicator
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: The periodic table (8F); breathing and respiration (8C)
source: Written for science/y8 lesson 27 (Home practical guide and safety card: red cabbage indicator (portal worksheet; adult chops and pours hot water, never use bleach))
intro: Lesson 27: Chemical properties: acidic and basic oxides. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To make an indicator from red cabbage and test kitchen liquids
equipment: Lemon juice, vinegar, bicarbonate of soda solution, soapy water (no bleach or cleaning products)
safety: Adult chops and pours hot water
An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: An adult chops the cabbage and pours hot water over it
Leave for 10 minutes, then sieve the purple liquid
Pour a little into each cup
Add a few drops of one test liquid to each
Sort: acid (pink or red), neutral (purple), alkali (green or blue)

questions.q: Big question: where does the acid in acid rain come from?
questions.a: Non-metal oxides from burning fuels dissolve in rainwater.
